function.name: inspect_asset
function.description: Return real pixels of an original or previous crop. Can zoom with crop.

function.name: crop
function.description: Return actual crop pixels. bbox is [left,top,right,bottom] normalized 0..1000, where 50 percent is 500, relative to full page or selected asset. Use complete related panels and labels. Can revise with another call.

function.name: render_pages
function.description: Render physical pages for a closer look, in one batch. Crop coordinates remain relative to each full page, not this contact sheet. At most 8 pages.
